Name: AtlasV Collection Catalogue
Author: AtlasV1224
Description:
Do you have any mods of mine from the AtlasV Collection and are tired or have no way of spawning them in? or feel it's too cheaty to spawn them in?

Worry no more! For this mod is what you need!

This mod adds a custom catalogue bought from Robin the Carpenter for 15,000g with all the items from my AtlasV Collection mods you have installed.


This mod requires both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿, bundled with the mod are a few alternative textures matching to the vanilla Stardew furniture sets.
I also HIGHLY recommend you install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url] as the catalogue has built in support for it and it makes it so much easier to find items. This mod isn't required, just recommended.

[u][size=4]Installation:
[/size][/u]All you have to do is extract the "AtlasVCatalogue" folder into your Stardew mods folder! It's that easy!


Please report any bugs you find in the "Bugs" tab, it makes it so much easier to track and fix issues.


[u]Currently supported content packs:
[/u]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35598](CP) Atlas Of Paths[/url]﻿
[*]With more to come!
[/list]

Thank you to all the lovely people in the Stardew Valley Discord who helped me figure out many things I became stuck on!
